_mo_ta: Chinh sach DAST phien ban hoa (G3.3). Mot noi duy nhat, review qua git, dast_scan.py doc va ap dung. Gom hai phan: active (cau hinh active scan cua ZAP) va runtime (rule kiem tra header/cookie luc chay).

active._mo_ta: Cau hinh active scan. Pipeline chay policy goc cua ZAP (mac dinh); che do --do-nhay cao day cac ho rule ung voi CWE len strength/threshold duoi day. Danh sach CWE lay tu tools/correlate.py (CWE_ZAP_SCANNER).

runtime._mo_ta: Rule kiem tra luc chay (header bao mat + co cookie). Soi phan hoi HTTP that cua ung dung dang chay. Mac dinh REPORT-ONLY. Rule nao danh dau lam_khoa=true thi dua len Code Scanning duoi mot cong cu RIENG ten 'DAST-runtime' (nguong Medium, tach khoi cong High cua OWASP-ZAP) va CO QUYEN CHAN merge khi xuat hien phat hien MOI; cac rule con lai van report-only o trang Summary. G3.3 chon CSP va X-Frame-Options (Medium, 0 bao nham) lam khoa sau khi main da sach.

header.cach_sua: Them header Content-Security-Policy voi chinh sach that chat (vd default-src 'self') de giam XSS va chen tai nguyen.
Them X-Frame-Options: DENY (hoac SAMEORIGIN) de chong clickjacking; hoac dung frame-ancestors trong CSP.
Them X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff de trinh duyet khong tu doan MIME.
Tren HTTPS, them Strict-Transport-Security de ep trinh duyet luon dung HTTPS.

cookie.cach_sua: Dat co HttpOnly cho cookie phien de JavaScript (XSS) khong doc duoc.
Tren HTTPS, dat co Secure de cookie khong bi gui qua ket noi khong ma hoa.
Dat SameSite=Lax hoac Strict de giam CSRF.
